fact: During the maintenance phase June 2023 to August 2024, 10 legacy programme MISs, including SAGE, NUSAF3 and DRDIP, were integrated with the upgraded National Single Registry (Version 2), which consolidates beneficiary, payment, complaint and exit data across programmes.
title: Maintenance of National Single Registry (NSR): Closing Report
publisher: Ministry of Gender, Labour & Social Development (MGLSD)
